Token Time meters every token your AI agents burn and taps you on the shoulder when it's time to take a break.

## A quiet meter for an unstoppable habit.

### Menu-bar meter

Your live token count and today's spend, always one glance away in the macOS menu bar. No dashboard to open.

### Live usage chart

See tokens by the hour across the day, so you can spot the runaway sessions the moment they start climbing.

### Cost & per-model breakdown

Tokens, dollars, and how today compares to your baseline, split by model, so you know exactly where spend goes.

### Lock-screen nudges

A full-screen reminder every time you cross a threshold. It auto-dismisses in 10s, just enough to make you look up.

### Configurable thresholds

Set the nudge to fire every N million tokens. Tune how often Token Time interrupts you, or barely at all.

### Runs locally, stays private

No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Your usage data never leaves your Mac. Download it and it just works.

## Live in your menu bar

Token Time runs quietly in the background and keeps today's usage right where you can see it. Click the icon for the full picture: the hourly chart, the running cost, and your lock-screen settings.

## Get the short break you deserve

When you've been heads-down too long, Token Time gently takes over your screen for ten seconds. Breathe, stretch, look away. Then it hands the day back to you.

## Your usage stays on your Mac.

No account to create, no server to phone home to. Token Time reads your usage locally and keeps every number on your device.
